name: valid_scalar_constraint
preamble: type Box<T extends string> = { value: T };

name: invalid_scalar_constraint
preamble: type Box<T extends string> = { value: T };

name: valid_structural_constraint
preamble: type Wrap<T extends { x: string }> = T;

name: invalid_structural_constraint
preamble: type Wrap<T extends { x: string }> = T;

name: valid_dependent_key_constraint
preamble: type Picked<T, K extends keyof T> = { [P in K]: T[P] };

name: invalid_dependent_key_constraint
preamble: type Picked<T, K extends keyof T> = { [P in K]: T[P] };

name: default_argument_constraint
preamble: type Box<T extends string = 'x'> = { value: T };

name: dependent_default_argument
preamble: type Box<T extends string, U extends T = T> = { value: U };
